name: qa_usbdisk_chord_f1_f7
title: OS-USBDISK U1d, QA-GLB-016: power on holding F1 + F7 without Shift: no disk mode

steps.say: OS-USBDISK U1d, row QA-GLB-016, case f1_f7: hold F1 + F7 without Shift while powering the unit on, then start this run. Nothing is injected, nothing is written

steps.note: the chord was read and is not the disk chord
a normal boot: the Tracker owns the card (a card in the slot is mounted)
